svg.title: Sliding the robot across the tape
svg.desc: An animation, close up and seen from above, of the Lesson 2-1 test. A strip of black tape runs up the picture. With the motors off, the robot is slid by hand from the right of the tape, across it to the left, and back again, while test_sensors() prints a line about every tenth of a second. Beside it, the shell scrolls those lines: Left and Right both about 0.20 on the white floor; as the robot crosses, the left sensor reaches the tape first and climbs to about 0.80 while the right still reads 0.20, then both read about 0.5 with the tape between them, then the right one reads 0.80 as the left one leaves, and both fall back to about 0.20 once the robot is past.
svg.text: Sliding the robot across the tape
motors off: you slide the robot
About 0.2 on the white floor, about 0.8
on the black tape. Each sensor climbs as
it moves onto the tape and drops as it
leaves, and the left one gets there first
